description: A checker: says whether a run's work is good by a command, run in a copy of where the run worked as the run left it — its project, or its workspace where it had one. Named as a run's checkWith.

parameters.command?: string: the command that says whether the work is good (npm test) — the checker's own, said in its meta.json
parameters.seconds?: number: how long the command may take (600) — the checker's own too
parameters.result?: json: what the run ended with — handed by the runner to whoever checks a run, as all that follows is
parameters.args?: json: what the run was asked with
parameters.journal?: string: the path of the run's record
parameters.used?: json: what the run had used of a model when its check began: { calls, tokens, cost }
parameters.workspace?: string: where the run worked, where that was not its project

returns.ok: boolean: whether the command ended well, in time
returns.notes: string: how it ended, and the end of what it printed

input.prompt: A checker: says whether a run's work is good by a command, run in a copy of the project as the run left it.
